description: How a capability is reached. Closed, for the same reason data_domain is: left open it produced 28 spellings for 19 kinds, including `doc` beside `docs`, `wire` beside `wire-contract`, and `sse` beside `event-stream`. A capability graph whose systems describe the same kind of entry point differently cannot be queried across them.

http.description: An HTTP route the system serves

webhook.description: An inbound callback the system accepts

agent-tool.description: A tool registered for an agent to call in-process, including in a browser

ts-api.description: An importable TypeScript or JavaScript API

ui.description: A surface a human operates directly

file.description: A file or dataset the system reads or writes

contract.description: A declared interface with no runtime entry point of its own

doc.description: Documentation that is itself the surface

manual.description: An operator procedure with no automated entry point

external.description: Provided by a third party outside the estate
